preprocessing.unknown_category_policy: evaluation encoder ignores OOV; serving rejects OOV; split-level OOV evidence recorded

protocol.scope: benchmark evaluation only; not a hiring validity study
protocol.validation_strategy: joint stratification by income, sex, and race_binary

fnlwgt.semantics: Census final sampling weight retained only for descriptive audit and weighted sensitivity analysis. It is excluded from predictive features.

policy.statement: Predictions, probabilities, thresholds, and policy outputs are fixed inputs; the audit only filters evaluation rows.

sampling_weight_sensitivity.interpretation: CPS final weights are used only to compare weighted and unweighted rates; these are not Census design-based confidence intervals.

selective_review.scope: Global probability-only review policy; human review quality is not measured by this benchmark.

uncertainty.method: paired stratified bootstrap over test rows

overlap_excluded_retuning.statement: The model and validation probabilities stay fixed; only policy selection is repeated after exact-feature overlap exclusion.
